paragraphs.text: Eriana is a kor from an unknown plane who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where she has a bounty outstanding.

Eriana is a renowned outlaw on Thunder Junction . A kor with long, pale gray hair and pale skin, she is easily recognizable in her Hellspurs attire. Her armor is rigid and black, interwoven with glowing lava and burning fire elements upon its ridges, characteristic of the Hellspurs' fearsome style.

Eriana has earned the moniker Wrecking Ball , as she is notorious for her explosive entry into places, leaving massive holes in walls as she makes her escape. Her weaponry consists of dual swords, and her audacious heists include notable incidents such as robbing the Sterling Company , where she made off with two sacks full of money. Her reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by her ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on her back.
